verdict.rationale: Claude Design supports a Claude Code integration (/design-sync, /design) and packages a 'handoff bundle' that a coding agent can consume to implement a design, and one community report describes an MCP-based export flow into PenPot with reusable components/tokens. However, there is no vendor documentation of a dedicated Claude Design MCP server or public API exposing frames, variables, screenshots, and component mappings for arbitrary coding agents to pull — the evidence only shows first-party Claude Code slash-command integration and a third-party anecdote. Missing for 10: documented MCP server/API spec for Claude Design, evidence of variable/screenshot/component-mapping retrieval, and independent confirmation beyond one anecdotal HN comment.
